ghi_chu.mo_ta: Three or four small dark, torpedo-shaped objects trail long white wakes in the open water. They have no visible mast, sail or oars. They look like modern motorboats or torpedoes.
ghi_chu.ly_do: Nothing in 1780 matches this shape. Powered launches and torpedoes did not exist, and boats of the period were sail or oar driven with visible rigs or oars.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: Dark wakes with white trails at the other locations in the mid-sea. The most visible are around x 0.52–0.56, y 0.55–0.57, and x 0.63–0.66, y 0.51–0.53.
ghi_chu.ly_do: These look like fast powered craft leaving straight wakes. This is not consistent with 1780 sail or oar boats.
